evals.expected_output: Live read-only inspection in `ap-south-1` confirming 0 MWAA environments, followed by the exact Path A (`references/testing-provisioned.md`) workflow: `GET /dags/daily_orders_etl`, explicit confirmation gate before `POST /dags/daily_orders_etl/dagRuns`, recording `was_paused_before_test` to re-pause in cleanup if the test unpaused it, discrete single-call polling (never a blocking `while`+`sleep` loop), and delegating to `debugging-mwaa-workflow` if any task fails.
